linker_classes.name: Hydrazone linker
linker_classes.release_logic: Hydrazone hydrolysis accelerates in acidic endosomes and lysosomes.

linker_classes.name: Disulfide linker
linker_classes.release_logic: Disulfide exchange or reduction releases payload in high-GSH intracellular compartments.
limitations: bystander release can be hard to tune

linker_classes.name: Val-Cit-PABC linker
linker_classes.release_logic: Cathepsin cleavage at Val-Cit exposes PABC, then self-immolation releases payload.

linker_classes.name: Thioether maleimidocaproyl linker
linker_classes.release_logic: Payload exposure depends on antibody degradation and payload-linker catabolite activity.
limitations: payload must tolerate residual linker adduct

linker_classes.name: Beta-glucuronide linker
linker_classes.release_logic: Beta-glucuronidase removes a hydrophilic glucuronide cap, enabling self-immolation.
